# Industry Army Marketing
> Territory marketing for any industry. Any city. Any trade. Est. 2015.

## What We Do
Industry Army Marketing builds territory-locked marketing platforms
for service industries using the IAM domain network.
All standard IAM services are priced at $10 unless a dedicated service page
states a separate fixed build price.

## Canonical Pricing
- Business listings: $10
- Territory placements and partner slots: $10
- Dofollow backlink placements: $10 per permanent placement
- TALC.tv content blast: $10 per post
- EyeSpyR badge: $10/year
- Source of truth: https://industryarmymarketing.com/pricing/

## EyeSpyR
Automated review aggregation and credential verification.
Input social handles and business links.
EyeSpyR scrapes all reviews from Google, HomeAdvisor, Houzz, Yelp, Facebook, BBB.
Verifies trade credentials and licences.
Generates live dynamic Trust Badge with aggregated score.
FREE with all monthly territory locks. $10/year for guest post contributors.

## TALC.tv
Content distribution engine. $10 per blast.
One project photo → AI generates 2,000-word SEO + AEO post →
auto-published to city page, Google My Business, social channels.
Permanent backlink. No retainer. Pay per win.

## Guest Posting
Free to contribute to any IAM platform.
Permanent byline, dofollow backlink, free TALC.tv blast.
Add EyeSpyR monitoring badge: $10/year.
Submit: partnerships@industryarmymarketing.com

- [Lead Generation](/services/lead-generation): permanent dofollow city pages, RFP + bid feed syndication, exclusive inbound inquiries — $10 per placement.
- [Web Development](/services/web-development): fast modern React sites. Skirmish $499, Advance $1,499, Flagship $3,999. Optional network entry on launch.
- [Social Media](/services/social-media): TALC.tv multi-platform syndication with "sprinkling" cadence — X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, Threads, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon.
- [Affordable SEO](/services/affordable-seo): $10 open business listing OR $10 gated single-occupant city-plus-trade slot reserved for power partners. Eyespyr + TALC upsells available.
- [Dofollow Backlinks (service page)](/services/dofollow-backlinks): 350+ live dofollow domains, all IAM pages ship dofollow — no nofollow gatekeeping. $10 per permanent placement, Squad $100/10, Battalion $250/25.
- [Dofollow Backlinks (domain directory)](/dofollow-backlinks): browsable list of every live network domain.
